content.short: Trevee, formerly Rings, is a yield-bearing meta-stablecoin for USD and ETH with earn vaults on Plasma.
content.description: Trevee grew out of Rings, a meta-stablecoin for USD and ETH that offered yield to stakers and supplied liquidity to DeFi projects through its lockers. Under the Trevee name it runs earn vaults, including on Plasma. Meta-stablecoins wrap other stable assets and route their backing into yield strategies, which is where the return comes from.
